title: Joash Becomes King and Elisha Dies
description: Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, becomes king over Israel in Samaria and does evil in the Lord's sight. He visits the sick prophet Elisha, who gives him a prophetic sign with a bow and arrows about victory over Aram at Aphek. Joash strikes the arrows against the ground only three times, and Elisha says that because of this he will strike Aram only three times. Then Elisha dies and is buried.
